title: Claim.
bodyText: A claimant who desires to claim additional unemployment benefits shall file a claim pursuant to section 383-32.
bodyHtml: §385-8  Claim.  A claimant who desires to claim additional unemployment benefits shall file a claim pursuant to section 383-32. [L 1961, c 157, pt of §1; Supp, §93B-9; HRS §385-8]
